namedPlaces.evidence: Café 18 do Forte and Confeitaria Colombo – Café do Forte serve breakfast, lunch and brunch from the Fort at the southwest tip of the beach, offering an amazing view  of Rio.

namedPlaces.name: GAJOS D’OURO

namedPlaces.name: Bar Bip Bip
namedPlaces.evidence: Bar Bip Bip in Copacabana is a very (very) informal local hang out that often hosts choro and samba musicians. They usually post their latest schedule on Instagram, but hours are flexible as musicians wander in and out. Make sure to follow the rules while you’re there! (Part of the fun is figuring it out.)

namedPlaces.name: The Blue Note
namedPlaces.evidence: The Blue Note in Copacabana is an excellent place to watch Bossa Nova, Jazz and other shows.

namedPlaces.name: Pedra do Arpoador
namedPlaces.evidence: Ipanema is the Goldilocks of beach neighborhoods: just a touch more upscale than Copacabana and a touch less than Leblon. The Pedra do Arpoador at the Northeast tip of the beach offers an excellent vantage point to see the neighborhood.  Posto 9, a lifeguard post on Ipanema Beach marked by rainbow flags, has long served as a vibrant social hub for sunbathing, socializing, and parties, with nearby Rua Farme de Amoedo offering LGBTQ+-friendly bars and restaurants.
